header.eyebrow: Published Pricing — No Sales Calls Required
header.title: Pricing
header.intro: We publish our prices because we think you should be able to compare us to Workiva, Watershed, Persefoni, and everyone else without booking a demo first.

starter.description: For a single team validating Nexus before committing.

team.description: Production use across every framework, unlimited users.
team.f2: All frameworks (CSRD, ISSB, GRI, TCFD, CDP, SEC)

enterprise.description: For groups, regulated industries, and on-prem deployments.

why.heading: Transparency is the product.
why.p1: Most ESG platforms hide their numbers behind a "Request a demo" button. The reason is simple: they price every customer differently, and they don't want you comparing notes. We think that's the wrong instinct for a category whose job is making companies more transparent.
why.p2: So we publish ours. £0 to start, £500/month for the Team tier, custom for Enterprise. No per-disclosure overages, no implementation tax, no surprise renewal hikes. If you outgrow a tier we'll tell you ahead of renewal — not blindside you with a bill.
why.p3: If you need to procure a budget, you can do the maths from this page. If you want to compare us against <link>Workiva</link> or anyone else, you can do that too. That's the point.

changePlans.a: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing period.

nonProfit.q: Do you offer non-profit or academic pricing?
nonProfit.a: Yes — contact sales. We typically offer the Team plan at 50% off for verified non-profits and academic institutions.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Credit card and ACH/wire for Team. Invoice + purchase order for Enterprise. Multi-year contracts available with discount.

setupFee.a: No setup fee for Starter or Team. Enterprise may include a one-time onboarding fee scoped during procurement.

ctaBand.heading: Still deciding? Talk to a human.
